# Maureen Ella

> Premium on-location bridal hair and makeup artist serving St. Augustine,
> Jacksonville, Palm Coast, Northeast Florida, and destination weddings.
> Calm, organized, photo-ready bridal beauty for wedding mornings.

Maureen Ella (formerly "Maureen at The Parlor" — theparlor.info now redirects
here) is a bridal hair and makeup business led by Maureen, an experienced
bridal hairstylist and makeup artist based in Northeast Florida. Services are
on-location: Maureen travels to the bride's venue or getting-ready location.
Pricing is provided by inquiry; there is no published price list.

Contact: maureen@theparlor.info · (904) 881-5808 · Daily, 6:00 AM–6:00 PM.
Inquiries do not reserve a date — availability is confirmed by response.

## Bridal services

- [Bridal overview](https://maureenella.com/bridal): what working with Maureen Ella looks like
- [Services](https://maureenella.com/bridal/services): bridal hair, bridal makeup, bridal party services, trials
- [FAQ](https://maureenella.com/bridal/faq): booking, trials, timing, travel questions
- [Prep guides](https://maureenella.com/bridal/prep-guides): hair prep, makeup prep, and trial prep guides for brides
